description: Defines interfaces and classes for E2 message handling, event management, connection management, and E2 agent control within the ocudu namespace, related to 3GPP specifications and RIC communication.

classes.name: e2_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling incoming E2 messages.

classes.name: e2_event_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling E2 events such as connection loss.

classes.name: e2_message_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying reception of new E2 messages.

classes.name: e2_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing E2 connection requests and setup procedures.

classes.name: e2_interface
classes.description: Combined interface for E2 message handling, event handling, and connection management.

classes.name: e2ap_e2agent_notifier
classes.description: Notifier interface for E2 agent disconnection events.

classes.name: e2_agent
classes.description: Public interface for an E2 agent, managing connection and setup.

methods.name: on_new_message
methods.description: Callback invoked on reception of a new E2 message.

methods.name: handle_e2_tnl_connection_request
methods.description: Request a new TNL connection to the RIC.

methods.name: handle_e2_setup_request
methods.description: Initiate E2 setup with a request message.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Start the E2 interface or agent.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stop the E2 interface or agent.

methods.name: on_e2_disconnection
methods.description: Notify disconnection event to the E2 agent.
